title: Solid State Physics I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the heat ΔQ which is required to raise the temperature by ΔT, i.e."
The heat capacity C is defined as the heat ΔQ which is required to raise the temperature by ΔT, i.e.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the surface of constant energy µR in k space."
The Fermi surface is the surface of constant energy µR in k space.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most commonly used notation for specifying points, directions, and planes in crystal lattice systems."
Miller indices are the most commonly used notation for specifying points, directions, and planes in crystal lattice systems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the acoustic branch, while the upper curve is called the optical branch."
The lower curve is called the acoustic branch, while the upper curve is called the optical branch.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very wide field, with many branches."
Solid state physics is a very wide field, with many branches.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sphere centered at k = 0."
The Fermi surface for free electrons is a sphere centered at k = 0.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of the course work."
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of the course work.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called an acceptor, because it accepts an electron to complete its tetrahedral bond."
The trivalent impurity is called an acceptor, because it accepts an electron to complete its tetrahedral bond.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the determination of the thermal conductivity of electrons treated as classical particles."
Electronic transfer is the determination of the thermal conductivity of electrons treated as classical particles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuing periodic oscillation relative to a fixed reference point, or a single complete oscillation."
Lattice vibration is a continuing periodic oscillation relative to a fixed reference point, or a single complete oscillation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability of a material to conduct electrical current."
Electrical conductivity is the ability of a material to conduct electrical current.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vector, parallel to the flow of charge, whose magnitude is the amount of charge per unit time crossing a unit area perpendicular to the flow."
The current density j is a vector, parallel to the flow of charge, whose magnitude is the amount of charge per unit time crossing a unit area perpendicular to the flow.
fib: ______ is the phenomenon on which the electrical resistivity of metals or alloys drop to zero (infinite conductivity) when cooled into its critical temperature.
Superconductivity
Superconductivity is the phenomenon on which the electrical resistivity of metals or alloys drop to zero (infinite conductivity) when cooled into its critical temperature.
______ is the simplest way to represent the electronic structure of metals.
free electron model
A free electron model is the simplest way to represent the electronic structure of metals.
______ is the energy distribution of particles that obey the Pauli Exclusion Principle.
Fermi energy surface
Fermi energy surface is the energy distribution of particles that obey the Pauli Exclusion Principle.
______ is an experimental method to study scattering of crystal based on Ewald's simple geometric construction.
Experimental crystal structure determination
Experimental crystal structure determination is an experimental method to study scattering of crystal based on Ewald's simple geometric construction.
______ are the distinct lattice types which when repeated can fill the whole space.
Bravais lattices
The Bravais lattices are the distinct lattice types which when repeated can fill the whole space.
______ is the Group IV semiconductors - C (diamond), Si, ­0, - all of which lie in the fourth column of the periodic table.
best-known class
The best-known class is the Group IV semiconductors - C (diamond), Si, ­0, - all of which lie in the fourth column of the periodic table.
______ is defined as the average distances between two consecutive scattering events, so that F = $G, where τ is the average time between collisions which is called collision time or relaxation time.
mean free path

The mean free path is defined as the average distances between two consecutive scattering events, so that F = $G, where τ is the average time between collisions which is called collision time or relaxation time.
______ is the attractive inter atomic force that hold atom together in a crystal.
Crystal binding
Crystal binding is the attractive inter atomic force that hold atom together in a crystal.
______ is a measure of the number of degrees of freedom of oscillating lattice.
Specific heat
Specific heat is a measure of the number of degrees of freedom of oscillating lattice.
______ is called a phonon in analogy with the photon, which is the quantum of the electromagnetic wave.
quantum of vibration
The quantum of vibration is called a phonon in analogy with the photon, which is the quantum of the electromagnetic wave.
______ is a material whose atoms have a regular arrangement that exhibits translational symmetry.
crystalline solid
A crystalline solid is a material whose atoms have a regular arrangement that exhibits translational symmetry.
